cards.card: 白金信用卡（精英版）/钛金信用卡
上海奔驰白金联名信用卡

note: China's largest banks by assets are ICBC, China Construction Bank, Agricultural Bank of China and Bank of China; China Merchants Bank is among the largest card issuers. ICBC's and China Construction Bank's sites didn't answer this research's requests (no connection, 2026-10-30); Agricultural Bank of China's price list answers 403 (its access-control system); China Merchants Bank's service price catalogue (fin.paas.cmbchina.com) renders nothing without its script and comes back empty when rendered, and its card product pages return a stub; the PDFs a search found on its file store are gone (NoSuchKey). So only Bank of China is written. Bank of China's credit card price list (第五章 11 信用卡, in force from 11 November 2025, read 2026-10-30) sets the annual fee by the card's tier, which the price list states applies to every card the bank issues, a product's own fee being given in its application: an ordinary, gold or titanium card (普卡/金卡/钛金卡) at most 360 yuan, written at that ceiling as the 普卡 this file has held since 2026-10-29; a platinum card (白金卡) 800 yuan; a high-end card (高端卡) 3,600 yuan; a top card (顶级卡) 8,800 yuan. A domestic cash advance at the counter costs 1% of the amount, at least 10 yuan and at most 100 yuan (the Great Wall Global series' self-service rate is the same; the BOC series' self-service floor of 8 or 12 yuan isn't written); a cash advance abroad (3%, 30 to 180 yuan) isn't written, the form having one cash fee. A late payment costs 5% of the part of the minimum payment left unpaid (written as a share of the unpaid part), never more in a cycle than the principal overdrawn, a cap that isn't written. Bank of China's note on card charges and interest (中国银行信用卡服务收费及计息方式说明, read 2026-10-30): the overdraft rate is 0.05% a day, which it states as 19.9% a year, compounded monthly, written as that effective yearly rate; cash advances carry it from the day they're posted, with no free period; purchases go free of interest for 20 to 50 days when the statement is paid in full, written as 50. The foreign-transaction fee and the over-limit fee aren't stated in either document and aren't written (nor the minimum payment, written in wave 5 from the card agreement). Wave 4 (2026-10-30): Industrial Bank (兴业银行) and Ping An Bank (平安银行), two of the large joint-stock banks and card issuers whose card sites publish their price lists, are added; Bank of Communications', China Everbright's, Shanghai Pudong Development's and Minsheng's card sites didn't answer this research (no connection, 2026-10-30), and China CITIC Bank's card site was reached but its price list wasn't read for want of the research's budget. Industrial Bank's credit card price list (兴业银行信用卡收费标准, its card site, read 2026-10-30): the annual fee by tier, the main card's written: an ordinary card 80 to 100 yuan, written at 100; gold 200; platinum (elite edition) or titanium 500; platinum (精锐版) 600; platinum (悠 series) 900; platinum (standard edition) 2,600; Centurion platinum 6,000; diamond 15,000; Centurion black 38,666; the GOLF platinum 9,000 and the Shanghai Mercedes-Benz platinum co-brand 3,500 (the bank's discounts are in a separate list, not read, and aren't written); an IC card fee of 5 yuan at issue, written as the issue fee (special designs up to 3,888 aren't written); a late payment 5% of the unpaid part of the minimum, at least 20 yuan; a cash advance 2% of the amount, at least 20 and at most 500 yuan; the foreign-transaction fee 1.5% (on the dual-currency and Visa or Mastercard cards; written on every tier, the price list not naming which tiers carry which brands); the over-limit fee is on the government's free list and isn't charged. Its personal card agreement (兴业银行信用卡（个人卡）领用合约, read 2026-10-30): interest at 0.05% a day, which it states as about 18.25% a year by simple interest, compounded monthly, written as 18.25% a year, from the posting date on cash and on purchases not paid in full by the due date; the minimum payment 5% of the purchases within the limit, plus all cash advances, any amount over the limit, instalments, earlier unpaid minimums and all the period's fees, late charges and interest (written as 5% with the interest added; the cash advances' 100% and the fees aren't). The interest-free period runs from the posting date to the statement's due date, with no figure, and isn't written. Ping An Bank's card service price list (平安银行信用卡业务服务销售价格目录（市场调节价）（个人客户版）, read 2026-10-30): the main card's annual fee by class, each a range written at its top, the bank's waivers being per product and not read: diamond and above 10,000 to 38,800 yuan, platinum 200 to 6,000, standard gold 200 to 300, standard ordinary 65 to 100, and a class with no annual fee (the former Shenzhen Development Bank's gold and ordinary cards, no longer issued, aren't written); revolving interest 0.05% a day, which the list states as 18.25% a year by simple interest, compounded monthly, written as 18.25% a year, on cash and on balances not paid in full; a cash advance in China 2.5%, at least 25 yuan (abroad 3%, not written); a late payment 5% of the unpaid part of the minimum, at least 20 yuan (the whole principal where it's 20 yuan or less, not written). The SMS fee of 36 yuan a year is waived above 500 yuan of transactions, a condition the game doesn't check, and isn't written. Ping An's foreign-transaction fee wasn't on the list read and isn't written (nor its minimum payment, written in wave 5 from its card agreement). Wave 5 (2026-10-30), minimum payments: Bank of China's credit card agreement (中国银行股份有限公司信用卡领用合约, published February 2024, read 2026-10-30): the minimum is 10% of purchases within the limit, plus all cash advances, earlier unpaid minimums, any excess over the limit, all fees and interest and each instalment due, written on its four tiers as 10% with the interest added (the cash advances' 100% and the fees aren't modelled). Ping An Bank's credit card agreement (PAB612034-1, May 2026, read 2026-10-30), article 52: the minimum is all of the earlier unpaid minimum, fees, instalments, cash advances and over-limit sums, plus X of the purchases and other charges, X being 10% on the first statement and 2% to 5% after a first statement paid on time, as the bank sets for each holder; written on its five tiers at the least, 2% (the first statement's 10% and the bank's choice within the range aren't modelled).
